name: hw06-api-testing
description: HW06 - Automated API Testing for EShop SUT using Postman & Newman

scripts.test:all: npm run test:fr04 && npm run test:fr10 && npm run test:fr15 && npm run test:fr09
scripts.test:fr04: newman run collections/FR04_Profile_Management.postman_collection.json --env-var studentId=23127092 -r cli,htmlextra,json --reporter-htmlextra-export reports/FR04_Newman_Report.html --reporter-json-export reports/FR04_Newman_Report.json
